ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white dominates roughly 75-80% of the visible fluke surface, contrasted with low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels in discrete clusters and along the perimeter.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe: Concentrated black clusters at the base and inner margin, with isolated circular spots in the center. Right lobe: Diagonal distribution of circular dark blobs extending from the notch toward the upper-mid region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; approximate 45-degree angle at the vertex with deep penetration relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge. Noteworthy high-amplitude jagged indentation on the upper inner margin of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge leading to pointed, upward-swept distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High density of isolated circular black pixel clusters (rosettes) distributed across both lobes; roughly 18-22 distinct spots visible on the left lobe and 15-20 on the right.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Subtle vertical dark linear disruptions observed on the mid-to-lower portion of the left lobe's white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense, high-intensity textured clusters representing barnacle colonization on the distal tips and along portions of the trailing edges; significant black pigmentation loss/scarring at the fluke base near the notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced accumulation of white barnacles on the very outer edges creating a secondary irregular geometric silhouette beyond the natural fluke boundary.
